description:
thiserror is declared in 16 of 25 crate Cargo.toml files but actually used in only 2 (jmap-types, jmap-base-client). All 7 client crates and 7 server crates other than jmap-server declare it as a dep but never `use thiserror`.

Affected:
- crate-jmap-{calendars,chat,contacts,filenode,mail,sharing,tasks}-server (7)
- crate-jmap-{calendars,chat,contacts,filenode,mail,sharing,tasks}-client (7)

Either:
1. Remove the unused dep from those Cargo.toml files (a `cargo machete` run would also catch this; consider adding to CI).
2. Migrate the hand-rolled Display/Error impls (MockError, MemoryError, TrackError, AvailabilityError, etc.) to `#[derive(thiserror::Error)]` so the dep earns its keep.

Option 2 is the higher-yield fix because it also addresses JMAP-sc1b.X (AvailabilityError). Option 1 is faster and unblocks publish-readiness if the design is to keep error types hand-rolled in those crates.
title: P2: thiserror declared but unused in 14 crates
